summary: Two ankle injuries on Mount Sanitas ~12:30 p.m.: male boulderer fell ~10 ft onto a crash pad (rolled ankle, walked out, refused care); 23-year-old female climber fell ~1 ft (right ankle injury), littered to Sanitas Valley Trail, courtesy ride, refused care
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; City of Boulder Open Space and Mountain Parks; Sunshine Fire; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group
